sample_filters: non-missing values for all regression variables
lagged total assets at least $10 million
fields.dependent_var: INVEST: capital expenditures CAPX in t+1 divided by total assets AT in t
key_independent_vars: COVERAGE: log of one plus number of analysts with annual EPS forecast I/B/E/S
controls: LEV: DLTT + DLC divided by AT
MTB: PRCC_F x CSHO divided by CEQ
fields.subsamples: same sample; column 1 COVERAGE only; column 2 adds SIZE, LEV, MTB; column 3 adds CASH, ROA
fields.winsorization: continuous variables winsorized at the 1st and 99th percentiles of annual distributions
